title: setup hook --scope user --dry-run shows the diff and writes nothing; without --yes and a terminal it is refused
source: intended: docs/decisions.md v0.2 row (setup hook --scope user, plan 2.4): the guard registered in ~/.claude/settings.json for the owner's own session, same rules as project scope
intent: INTENDED behavior (plan 2.4). `--dry-run` prints the preview and `dry run, nothing written`, and the home folder stays without `.claude`. With no `--yes` and no terminal the command is `JITSO REJECTED` (exit 2) and also writes nothing. A project-scope `--remove --dry-run` is covered by `setup/hook/remove-dry-run`; here the user file is added, then `--remove --dry-run` keeps it.

stdout.regex: jitso setup hook: dry run, nothing written\n$
jitso setup hook: dry run, nothing written\n$
